sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Accounts Receivable Factoring and Cross-Border Reverse Factoring

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: predominantly Common Law (U.S.-derived corporate and commercial law), with Marshallese statutory law and customary land-law overlay
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: None in force as a dedicated bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement; the principal investment-protection framework is the Compact of Free Association with the United States of America (1986, as amended in 2003), supplemented by RMI domestic foreign investment, tax-exempt, and corporate law.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, as codified in the Marshall Islands Revised Code, together with the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2021 (as amended), the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit Regulations, and the RMI Business License/Foreign Investment Business Act to the extent applicable. Beneficial ownership data is collected and maintained by the licensed Registered Agent and is not filed in a public registry.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport bio-data page for each director, officer, shareholder holding at least 25%, and each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport issuing authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent apostille authority; if the origin is not a Hague Convention member, RMI Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Current proof of residential address of each UBO and director (bank statement or utility bill dated within 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank, utility provider, or municipal registry in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the issuing country; alternatively, RMI Consular Legalization for non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds letter (account standing, counterparty relationships, and projected funding flows)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution or certified public accountant in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as required under the origin country's authentication regime

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum and Articles of Association of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the originating registry's designated authentication office; non-Hague jurisdictions must follow RMI Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Corporate Existence for each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization in accordance with the issuing jurisdiction's treaty status

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, officers, shareholders above the 25% threshold, and ultimate beneficial owners against the UN Consolidated List, US OFAC SDN list, EU and UK financial sanctions lists, and RMI FIU designations. PEPs, PEP family members, and close associates require enhanced due diligence, including written source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Screening results and compliance files must be retained for at least five years and refreshed before each new factoring counterparty or beneficiary is onboarded.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands — electronic corporate registry accessible exclusively through licensed RMI Registered Agents; there is no general public filing portal.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate documents and statutory filings are made in English. A corporate name must use the standard 26-letter English/Roman alphabet, with no diacritical marks; Marshallese or foreign-language names must be transliterated into Roman characters. The name must end with a recognized corporate suffix such as 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Company', 'Limited', or an approved abbreviation such as 'Corp.', 'Inc.', 'Co.', or 'Ltd.', and must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing RMI registered or reserved name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended by filing a renewal application through the licensed Registered Agent before the initial 30-day window expires. If the Registrar rejects a proposed name, the Registered Agent may file an administrative appeal or reconsideration request within 14 days of the rejection notice, identifying distinctive amendments or, for sensitive tokens, attaching the prior written consent of the cognizant Minister or regulator. If ministerial consent is unobtainable or the Registrar affirms the rejection, the applicant may submit a new name reservation with an additional distinguishing element. Further judicial review may be pursued before the RMI High Court under applicable administrative procedure rules.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Under the Business Corporations Act, every RMI corporation must continuously maintain a registered office and a licensed Registered Agent at a physical street address in the Marshall Islands. A virtual mailbox, post-office box, or purely electronic address is not acceptable for the statutory registered office. However, for a non-resident Business Corporation, the physical statutory office may be the office of the licensed Registered Agent, and the company may conduct its trade and cross-border factoring operations entirely remotely without establishing a substantive place of management in the RMI.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 5% or less annual likelihood of unannounced inspection for a standard non-resident trade-financing corporation; the likelihood increases to approximately 25% if the entity obtains a regulated financing/factoring or money-services license, or if the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit selects the entity for AML/CFT on-site examination under the medium-risk enhanced supervision tier.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark service charge; not a statutory fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the RMI Business Corporations Act fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Corporate Existence (post-incorporation, required for banking and factor due diligence)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered Agent and registered office service, year one
Preparation of charter document set: Articles of Incorporation, Bylaws, organizational consents, and UBO register framework
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fixed fee for a non-resident Business Corporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT onboarding and UBO piercing: beneficial ownership identification, PEP/sanctions screening, and risk assessment file
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML compliance counsel / designated compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a medium-risk trade finance entity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, Hague Apostille or consular legalization, and courier of the due-diligence bundle (up to five documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, origin-country authentication authority or consulate, and international courier
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Cost-recovery disbursement plus fixed legal logistics fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preliminary license and regulatory gap assessment for ISIC 6492 accounts-receivable factoring and cross-border reverse-factoring activity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for regulatory due diligence

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, 1990, as amended (MIRC Title 33), particularly the formation provisions in Part II (Articles of Incorporation), Sections 26 (registered agent), 30 (registered office), 47-50 (shares), and 74-80 (directors and officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Companies Registration Section, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (with Certificate of Incorporation to be issued upon payment of fees).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital requirement is imposed under the Business Corporations Act; the Company may operate on subscribed capital, and for this factoring undertaking it is recommended to maintain an authorised capital of US$100,000 or 1,000,000 no-par-value shares. Funds are not required to be escrowed unless the registered agent or financing bank imposes a deposit condition, and such escrowed capital may be held in the Company's own account rather than a government escrow.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, as the first board of directors of MH_BC that: (1) the share subscriptions tendered by the founding subscribers for one fully paid share each in the Company’s authorized capital are approved, share certificates are directed to be issued, and the consideration received is accepted; (2) the registered office of the Company is established at the office of the appointed registered agent in Majuro, Marshall Islands, and said agent is confirmed in office; (3) the persons named as President, Corporate Secretary and Treasurer are appointed as the first officers with authority to open bank accounts, execute trade finance agreements and file all operational registrations; and (4) any legal or management member may take incidental actions to make these resolutions effective.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Authorised Capital Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI Online Corporate Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online name reservation application for the proposed corporate legal name MH_BC or a permitted variant ending in 'Corporation', 'Inc.', or 'Ltd.'. Confirm that the name is not misleading, is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity, and that the authorised share capital and share classes are described consistently with the Articles of Incorporation. Engage a licensed registered agent to act as the statutory registered agent and provide the agent's written consent with the reservation application.
required_dossiers: Written consent of the proposed registered agent
Identity and address particulars of the initial shareholder and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a name objection or correction notice, file an amended name request or choose an alternate reserved name through the same online portal; if the agent is disqualified, promptly replace the agent and refile the consent within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Lodgment of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Companies Registration Section, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed Articles of Incorporation in duplicate, together with the registered agent consent, director consent forms, and the name reservation certificate. The Articles must state the authorised capital, number of directors, registered office address, registered agent name, and the fact that the corporation is formed under the Business Corporations Act. Ensure signatures are notarised where the Articles are executed outside the Marshall Islands.
required_dossiers: Consent of each named director to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried, the Registrar will issue a notice of correction; the applicant must file corrected Articles and obtain a fresh notarisation if required. A refusal may be cured by re-submitting with a revised registered agent or by applying for administrative rectification under the Business Corporations Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of State Fees and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations together with RMI Revenue and Customs cashier
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the prescribed incorporation fee and any applicable registered agent filing fee via corporate bank wire or through the licensed registered agent’s portal. After Treasury confirmation of the State fee, request issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation and the official company Extract, including the registration date, registered office and initial directors.
required_dossiers: Contact details for Director / Company Secretary receiving the Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate is not issued within the prescribed service level, file a written request with the Registrar for written reasons. Cure any outstanding fees, correct the registered office, or replace the registered agent, and obtain a reissued Certificate once the Registry is satisfied.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Organisational Meeting and Corporate Governance Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Corporate Secretary of MH_BC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or obtain unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting. Adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution, approve the authorised share subscription, issue share certificates, adopt corporate By-Laws, approve the bank resolution, designate signatories, and establish statutory corporate, accounting and minute books at the registered office or with the corporate secretary.
required_dossiers: Written consent of directors in lieu of meeting
Share subscription agreements and share certificates
Bank resolution and authorised signatory list
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any director unavailable, the written consent mechanism under the Business Corporations Act cures the absent meeting. Any inaccurate share register or officer minutes may be corrected by a supplemental board resolution and amended minutes filed with the corporate records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business License, Anti-Money Laundering Registration and Physical Premises Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Licensing Division, RMI Revenue and Customs; Financial Intelligence Unit; Environmental Protection Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a business license application for trade-supply-chain factoring and reverse factoring services, together with the Certificate of Incorporation, lease or ownership proof for the Majuro physical office, a completed AML/CFT risk assessment, and the proposed factoring operations policy. Register with the Financial Intelligence Unit if the factoring operation is treated as a non-depository financial institution engaged in lending or trade finance under the AMLA. Obtain the Environmental Protection Authority registration statement for a low-impact commercial office and secure fire safety and health clearances.
required_dossiers: Company Extract and current registered agent certificate
Lease agreement or title deed for registered office
Fire Safety Certificate or inspection request
Occupational health and workplace safety declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business Licensing Division issues a query, respond within 14 calendar days with amended financial crime controls or revised premises documents. If the FIU classifies the activity as regulated financial business, submit the outstanding AML registration and adopt FIU directions before the licence is issued; a refusal may be appealed to the Minister of Finance within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licensing Division, RMI Revenue and Customs and Financial Intelligence Unit of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Trade-Finance Factoring and Reverse Factoring Business License (Class F-2 – Non-Depository Trade Finance Activity) under the Business Licenses Act 2014

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Third Schedule Class 3 – Low Impact Commercial/Office Activity. Only an environmental registration statement is required; no full EIA study is mandated for a factoring administration office with no manufacturing, chemical storage, or waste discharge.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source discharge to Majuro lagoon is permitted. Wastewater is limited to domestic sanitary discharges through a licensed package treatment plant holding a discharge standard of ≤10 mg/L BOD and ≤10 mg/L total suspended solids. No volatile organic compound-emitting processes, combustion equipment or hazardous waste streams are authorised. All e-waste and confidential trade-finance files must be disposed of through a licensed waste transporter with a chain-of-custody manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The physical office must obtain a Fire Safety Certificate from the RMI Department of Fire and Emergency Preparedness, complete an annual evacuation drill, and secure a structural load inspection certificate from the Ministry of Public Works for the premises floor area where safes and record storage are installed. Occupational clearance must be issued by the Ministry of Health, confirming first-aid provision, sanitation, and compliance with workplace safety requirements for the office and any factoring in-floor records vault.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Tax and Revenue Office (TRO), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro, RMI); filing is paper-based and there is no operational national e-filing taxpayer portal. The separate corporate registry is the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An offshore non-resident Business Corporation is not required to obtain a tax identification number: its sole statutory identifier is the corporate registration number issued by the Registrar of Corporations upon filing articles of incorporation through a licensed Majuro registered agent. If the BC elects to carry on business within RMI, it must first obtain a Foreign Investment Business License, then file the prescribed business license application with the TRO, pay the gross-receipts license fee, and be issued a TIN; thereafter the company files annual license returns and, if it employs staff, registers as a wage and salary tax withholding employer.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: a Marshall Islands Business Corporation that is beneficially owned by non-residents, transacts no business within RMI, and derives no income from sources within RMI is exempt from all Marshall Islands income, business license, and wage taxes; its only recurrent state imposts are the modest annual franchise fee and registered-agent fee paid to the corporate registry.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None equivalent to a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election: RMI tax law contains no entity classification election and no alignment with foreign hybrid rules. The operative practical mechanisms are (i) the incorporators' designation/resolution creating the BC as a non-resident, tax-exempt corporation and (ii) the optional later election to obtain an onshore Business License, which converts the entity from Tax_Exempt_Zone status to full RMI gross-receipts and wage-tax exposure; revocation of the license returns it to exempt status for future periods.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Not applicable: the Republic of the Marshall Islands does not operate a VAT, GST, or general Sales and Use Tax. The indirect fiscal levies are limited to customs import duties on physical imports into RMI and the Business License Tax, a non-creditable gross-receipts turnover tax (headline rate 3%) on persons carrying on business inside RMI.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: USD 0 — no VAT/GST registration threshold exists because there is no VAT/GST regime. Customs duty registration applies to all importers of record without a de minimis value threshold, and Business License Tax liability attaches from the first US dollar of gross revenue derived from business activity carried on in RMI.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API reporting, continuous-transaction-control, or digital stamping mandate is in force; RMI customs and tax administration rely on paper declarations and manual records. Invoice copies must be retained by the taxpayer and produced on TRO demand, but no national fiscal database or approved invoicer certification is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable: absent a VAT/GST regime, RMI offers no export zero-rating, input-tax-credit, or VAT refund mechanism. Physical exports are exempt from customs duties when covered by an RMI export declaration, while cross-border factoring and reverse-factoring services (ISIC 6492) are sourced and performed outside RMI and therefore fall entirely outside the RMI tax base, requiring no zero-rating claim. RMI imposes no exchange control or statutory FX-repatriation deadline; the 180-day parameter is retained solely as the customary trade-finance settlement benchmark for cross-border receivable remittances.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: None required for services: offshore factoring, discounting, and reverse-factoring settlements involve no RMI customs or tax documentation; the bank file (SWIFT MT103/MT202, escrow statements, and receivable assignment notices) constitutes the evidentiary record.

For physical goods exported through RMI customs territory: an RMI Customs Export Declaration, commercial invoice, and, where applicable, bill of lading or airway bill; the Marshall Islands does not tax exports.

Audit preservation bundle: executed factoring agreements, invoice assignment schedules, and inward settlement certificates are retained as anti-money-laundering evidence, given the Medium_Risk_Enhanced classification of the trade-finance activity.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There is no VAT refund to claw back, so the enforceable exposure is the status audit: if the TRO determines that the BC performed factoring services for RMI obligors or derived RMI-source fees, it will retroactively withdraw the Tax_Exempt_Zone classification and assess unpaid Business License Tax, wage and salary tax, statutory monthly interest from the original due dates, late-filing penalties, and civil fraud penalties. A knowingly false customs export declaration or forged shipment evidence exposes the entity to seizures, smuggling fines, and criminal prosecution; factoring files must therefore prove non-RMI obligor situs and offshore settlement to sustain the exemption.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands does not maintain a domestic central bank; the U.S. dollar is sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association, and banking supervision and foreign-exchange administration are exercised by the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Majuro.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility with zero statutory exchange controls: capital and current account transactions (including inward equity, factoring advances, and profit remittances) may be freely converted and transferred in USD; no repatriation permit, dividend tax, or remittance surcharge is imposed, the only operative hurdles being correspondent-bank AML/KYC screening and U.S. sanctions enforcement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender obligation exists: export-related receivables and factoring proceeds may be retained offshore or repatriated freely in USD without mandatory conversion ratios or statutory timeline, as the Marshall Islands imposes neither exchange-control surrender rules nor obligatory repatriation windows.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Marshall Islands (BMI), Majuro Head Office
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational / Settlement Account for Corporate Factoring
Collections Escrow and Escrow Clearing Account
Not applicable — development-lending mandate without cross-border treasury services

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-High as a non-resident settlement conduit for receivables collections, low as a primary deposit keeper. Legal constraints: the Marshall Islands has no domestic EMI licensing regime, so an offshore digital EMI (EU/UK/Singapore licensed) may lawfully service a non-resident Business Corporation, provided the EMI does not take deposits from domestic residents and the BC maintains at least one licensed bank account as the principal clearing layer for factoring advances.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person appearance of beneficial owners and authorized signatories at the Majuro branch is the prevailing bank standard; fully remote account opening for non-resident corporations is not available. Acceptable alternatives on a case-by-case basis: apostilled corporate documents, notarized or consular-certified signatory oaths, board resolutions, and a video-conference KYC interview with a bank officer, plus a banking reference from the previous institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee shareholding or opaque UBO chain exceeding 10% ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified register of shareholders, trust deeds/declarations of trust for every nominee layer, passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners, PEP database screening report, and a written source-of-wealth statement covering each UBO

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering red flags (over- or under-invoicing within factored receivable portfolios)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully executed factoring agreement, underlying supplier and buyer contracts, commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading or airway bills, proof of delivery, and an aged receivable ledger reconciling every advance

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment concentration to or from high-risk, embargoed, or sanctioned jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UN/O.F.A.C. and EU consolidated sanctions screening results, counterparty due diligence file, country-risk assessment memorandum, and documentary confirmation that no counterparty appears on a restricted list

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Disproportionate transaction velocity or cash turnover versus stated capitalization
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements, board-approved treasury forecast, capital injection schedule, three months of bank statements, and client source-of-funds declarations for all counterparties

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: USD capital injections arrive via SWIFT MT103 (or Fedwire/CHIPS) from the parent or sponsor through a New York, Hong Kong, or Singapore correspondent bank into the BC settlement account; remittance purpose code must state 'invested capital / equity injection', accompanied by a board resolution, capital schedule, and UBO declaration; no exchange-control permit is required, and the correspondent performs O.F.A.C./U.N. screening before the funds are credited to an escrowed capital holding ledger.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Factoring advances and supplier settlements clear via SWIFT MT103/MT102 cover payments from the BC settlement account, with trade payables dispatched under a documentary commercial letter of credit (UCP 600) issued by or confirmed through a licensed trade bank; each payout instruction references the underlying receivable identifier and commercial purpose code, and USD obligations are settled same-day via CHIPS/Fedwire in New York to eliminate value-date risk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Offshore USD cross-currency outright forwards (tenor ≤ 12 months) on EUR, GBP, JPY, and CNY covering monetized receivables
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on regional settlement currencies lacking active deliverable markets
Cross-currency swaps with an authorized international dealer bank for tenor-matched receivable-backed obligations
Plain-vanilla FX options on major convertible currencies to hedge reverse-factoring line exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, RMI Office of the Registrar, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the last day of the month of the corporation's incorporation anniversary each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of US$200 or 50% of the report fee, whichever is greater; no Certificate of Good Standing issued while delinquent; non-filing for two consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations / RMI National Treasury (collected with the Annual Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the last day of the incorporation anniversary month, concurrently with the Annual Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid franchise tax accrues penalties and the corporation is deemed not in good standing; continuous non-payment for two consecutive years permits administrative dissolution and strike-off from the Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent (Majuro, RMI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on each incorporation anniversary; agent consent must be renewed and any replacement agent appointed within 60 days of resignation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered agent results in the Registrar appointing a substitute agent or initiating administrative dissolution; service of legal process at the registered office remains valid.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Confirmation and AML/CFT Client Due Diligence Refresh
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: RMI Banking Commission AML/CFT Division via the licensed Registered Agent; UBO file retained by the agent with no public RMI registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days following each incorporation anniversary and again within 30 days after any transfer of shares or change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-refresh may cause the registered agent to resign or file a suspicious activity report with the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; persistent default can trigger the Registrar's administrative strike-off procedure.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit or public filing of financial statements for a non-resident exempt Business Corporation under the RMI Business Corporations Act. A statutory audit is triggered only if the entity holds a depository, insurance, or trust-company license under the RMI Banking Act, or if the Registrar or Banking Commission so orders. A trade-factoring company holding a money-lending license is subject to Banking Commission inspection but not an automatic public statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: US GAAP, applied by reference to the Delaware-derived RMI Business Corporations Act; IFRS is acceptable where required for foreign-parent group consolidation reporting (RMI does not issue its own domestic GAAP)

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: RMI does not maintain a public UBO register; the licensed registered agent is the AML/CFT custodian and must hold a current beneficial-ownership file. Directors must execute an annual UBO confirmation certificate listing all natural persons holding a 10% or greater direct or indirect interest and any individual exercising effective control. This confirmation is due within 30 days after each incorporation anniversary and again within 30 days after any share transfer; entries in the Register of Members must be updated before a transferee is recognized and before any dividend or voting right is exercised.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registered Office and Registered Agent records maintained at the RMI office

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$600-US$1,200 per annum for licensed RMI registered agent and registered office services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required for a non-resident exempt Business Corporation; voluntary or lender-required US GAAP audit typically US$4,000-US$8,000 per annum

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% applicable rate for a non-resident Business Corporation (nominal 3% statutory RMI corporate rate attaches only to income sourced within the Republic; not triggered by offshore factoring)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial exemption, not a tax holiday. The RMI Income Tax Act taxes income from sources within the Republic only; a non-resident BC deriving foreign-source fee income, discount income, and interest from cross-border trade receivables has zero RMI income tax liability. No preferential deduction or holiday regime exists. Non-resident BCs are also exempt from capital gains tax, dividend tax, and wealth taxes.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Not applicable - no RMI corporate income tax return form is required for a non-resident BC with no RMI-source income (territorial source rule under the Income Tax Act).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No income tax return deadline; non-filing status is evidenced through the annual corporate report filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No income tax return to file.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain a written determination that 100% of factoring income is foreign-source; document the residence of each debtor and the location of the underlying contracts and payment rails.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No penalty arises for non-filing of a non-existent return. If an audit later recharacterizes income as RMI-source, the entity faces the full underpayment (3% corporate tax), a 5% per month late-filing penalty (capped at 25%), interest, and a 50% civil fraud addition for deliberate misstatement.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: BC Annual Report - Office of the Registrar of Corporations (Majuro), administered by International Registries, Inc. (IRI) through its corporate registry online filing portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing is due within 30 days after the anniversary of the corporation's incorporation in each calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name and certificate number from the articles of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office and registered agent in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the IRI-appointed registered agent in Majuro; a physical RMI office is required and a PO Box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal business address outside the Republic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the operational office managing the factoring portfolio; absence of any operational address is a shell-company indicator.
List all current directors and officers with full names and addresses; directors need not be RMI residents or citizens.
Describe the activity precisely as cross-border accounts-receivable factoring and reverse factoring, and reference the required factoring financial-business license or FIU registration number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of gross income derived from sources within the Republic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare 'None' or 'USD 0' where all debtors, obligors, and funding counterparties are outside the RMI; any RMI-resident obligor triggers the 3% corporate tax and a tax return obligation.
Confirm BC status as a non-resident domestic corporation under the Business Corporations Act, and certify that no business was transacted within the Republic.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a late-filing penalty fee; failure to file and pay the annual registration fee for two consecutive years leads to involuntary dissolution by the Registrar, with reinstatement fees and penalties on restoration. A dissolved BC loses limited-liability protection for post-dissolution contracts.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the RMI imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions by a non-resident BC to its shareholders, whether resident or non-resident.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Administrative protocol is not applicable: the RMI has no comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network and no tax-residency certificate procedure for relief. The RMI is party to tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) with the United States and certain other jurisdictions; these support information exchange but do not provide withholding relief. The BC should retain board minutes and distribution records proving that dividends are paid solely from foreign-source retained earnings.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate for outbound royalties, factoring discount/interest, and debt-interest payments made by a non-resident BC to foreign lenders or IP owners; no treaty rate applies because no comprehensive DTA exists.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - RMI law imposes no Local File, Master File, or country-by-country reporting thresholds. The Income Tax Act contains a controlled-transaction allocation rule analogous to IRC Section 482, which applies only where RMI-source income is in issue. In practice, documentation is nonetheless required by the home jurisdiction of the beneficial owner (e.g., US CFC/GILTI, EU CFC/Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive rules) to substantiate arm's-length pricing of factoring discounts and guarantee fees.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI has no standalone Economic Substance Regulations comparable to BVI/Cayman. Substance obligations arise from: (1) the Business Corporations Act requiring a registered office, registered agent, and annual reporting; and (2) the RMI AML/CFT legal framework, which treats trade receivables factoring as a financial business requiring licensing/FIU registration with substantive local governance, record-keeping, and risk-management functions. A letter-box BC lacking a licensed factoring operation and genuine management functions is vulnerable to Registrar strike-off, loss of the territorial tax exemption, and adverse treatment under OECD/EU good-governance reviews.
